\mxunit{enrichment-pigeonhole-exercises}{The pigeonhole principle}
\mxsubtitle{High school · olympiad thinking \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 02}

\begin{exercise}
Show that among 25 people, at least three were born in the same month.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Choose six distinct numbers from $\{1,\ldots ,10\}$. Prove that two sum to 11.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Prove that among eight integers, two have a difference divisible by 7.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Five points lie in a square of side 2, including its boundary. Show that two are at distance at most $\sqrt{2}$.
\end{exercise}
